text:
sasha: Observed sudden P95 jump in eu-dedicated pool at ~17:20 UTC. P95 120ms -> 930ms, throughput down ~28%. Opening incident.

 deploy-bot: ALERT: latency_p95 > 500ms on dedicated/eu-west (10m window)

 jordan: Any correlation with kernel selector or batching?

 mei: Checking profiler now. Quick dump:
```
kernel_selection_summary:
  int8_fast_gemm: 72% -> 41%
  fallback_fp32_gemm: 28% -> 59%
kv_cache_stats:
  hit_rate: 0.88 -> 0.42
  eviction_rate: 3/s -> 19/s
batching:
  avg_batch_size: 4 -> 11
  latency_headroom: 200ms -> 40ms
```

 raj: Placement log shows one node group got 7 heavy endpoints placed due to malformed affinity rule (label parsed as "true" instead of "true:high"). That overloaded kernel capacity on those GPUs.

 sasha: Also see model quantization mismatch: some variants labeled `int8` but model blob is 4bit quant -> selector can't use int8 kernels and falls back to fp32 path.

 jordan: Ran `rbx profile --pool eu-dedicated --since 20m` output:
```
GPU0: util 94% mem 85% temp 78C
GPU1: util 92% mem 88% temp 80C
processes: 12 inference workers (4 heavy, 8 light)
queue_depth: 312 -> increasing
```

 mei: KV cache warmup failing because eviction policy churned keys: `max_keys` was set to 50k on that pool but heavy workloads need 200k. Looks like config drift after last deploy.

 raj: Found quota config error: tenant `adtech-prod` was granted `shared_quota: 1.0` instead of `0.01` due to decimal parse bug in promo script. They consumed >60% of pool slots.

 sasha: So root causes: (1) quota misconfig -> noisy neighbor, (2) placement affinity bug -> collocated heavy models, (3) quant/selector mismatch -> kernel fallback and higher cost.

 oncall-latency: Mitigations in flight:
 - rollback promo quota change for `adtech-prod` (raj)
 - restart placement-agent on eu-dedicated to re-balance (raj)
 - patch kernel selector to prefer software quant path only when blob metadata matches (mei)
 - increase KV cache max_keys to 250k and prewarm on 3 nodes (jordan)
 - route heavy traffic to fallback pool `dedicated-eu-burst` while rebalance completes (sasha)

 jordan: ETA for rollback + placement restart ~12m. After that we should see P95 drop under 300ms if KV warmup succeeds.

 mei: Will open quick PR for kernel selector guard and hotfix it to canary for 1 node group.

 sasha: I'll update the SLA breach doc and notify CS. Keep posting short perf snapshots here.

 raj: Rolled back quota at 17:28 UTC. Placement agent restart kicked off at 17:30 UTC.

 deploy-bot: INFO: placement-rebalance started for eu-dedicated at 17:30:12 UTC

 oncall-latency: FYI after quota rollback P95 -> 420ms, KV hit rate trending up to 0.65. Still above SLO but improving.

 sasha: Great. We'll keep this thread for final RCA and timelines. Thanks team :thumbsup:
